Financial Accuracy: Ensuring incentive fulfilment speed and accuracy maintain a near-zero failure rate, with prompt resolution protocols when discrepancies occur . Product Design is the largest discipline within the design organisation, with designers working in tight-knit squads alongside researchers, product managers, and engineers to solve real customer problems at scale. You’ll have excellent visual, UI and interaction skills, and the ability to think through complex interaction design. You’re a strategic thinker who can shape product direction across multiple areas and translate organisational goals into clear, actionable plans. You’re a role model for resilience, rational decision-making, and effective communication, even in challenging circumstances. You’re pragmatic and proactive, always looking for ways to improve Design’s impact at Monzo while balancing the need to “get the job done”. 🙌What’s in it for you 💰£110,000 - £125,000 + Equity ✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK. ✅ We can sponsor your visa. 📍This role can be based in our London office, but we re open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London). ⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences. 🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. ➕ Plus lots more! 🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps 30 minute call with our Recruiter, Tom 1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Design team 2 x 45-minute interviews covering Leadership Values and Strategy Impact This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! jobs.description: Who We Are At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual s freedom. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more. About The Opportunity This role sits under Globalization, covering language quality, local UX, content performance and generation, and product readiness for the Arabic market. We re looking for someone who treats localization as a product discipline, not a translation function, and who is hands-on with AI tooling in the localization workflow. We re looking for an experienced Arabic Language Manager to join our Globalization team. You ll own the end-to-end Arabic user experience — language quality, local UX, content performance, and product readiness — making sure Arabic-speaking users get a product that feels native, not translated. You ll also be an early adopter and optimizer of AI tooling in the localization workflow. Our team is actively building AI-assisted pipelines (prompt-based QA, AI content production, MT post-editing), and we expect every Language Manager to be comfortable applying, refining, and evaluating AI in their daily work. The position requires a strategic mind, well-versed in localization best practices, fluent in AI/LLM tools, excellent communication abilities, and a strong commitment to delivering superior localized user experiences that translate into measurable business impact. What You’ll Be Doing Language quality local UX : Lead language quality initiatives for Arabic; conducting localization reviews, UX testing, and identifying linguistic, functional, and cultural discrepancies to ensure an optimal local product experience. AI-assisted localization : Apply and refine LLM prompts and AI workflows to drive language quality, terminology consistency, and efficiency across Arabic content. Document and share prompt learnings with the team. Evaluate AI output quality systematically and flag issues. Cross-signal quality: Connect localization output to content performance and SEO signals in the Arabic market, turning user feedback and market data into measurable improvements in acquisition, conversion, and engagement. Cross-functional partnership: Partner with Product, Design, Content System, Engineering, Marketing, and SEO to influence upstream decisions, ensuring Arabic users get a fully localized experience (not just translated strings), including RTL behavior, cultural appropriateness, dialect/MSA tone choices, and content readiness. Project leadership: Lead Arabic localization projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely delivery and quality outcomes. Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders and external vendors to align on goals, timelines, and quality bars. Customer advocacy: Champion Arabic-speaking users by researching, gathering, and synthesizing customer feedback. Offer insights on UI, UX, content, and design to enhance the local user experience. Vendor management: Work with the team to assess language service providers and freelancers; delivering feedback, training, and performance management to uphold high-quality standards. Asset governance: Maintain Arabic translation assets (style guide, glossary, translation memory) and ensure they evolve with the product and the market. Market intelligence: Engage cross-functional teams with insights on Arabic market potential; identifying opportunities, threats, and competitor activities by segment/country within the region to inform strategic decisions. Brand voice: Ensure all localized content adheres to global brand guidelines while maintaining a distinct Arabic brand tone that resonates with the local market and drives engagement and conversion. What We Look For In You Native fluency in Arabic and business proficiency in English. BA or equivalent in translation, linguistics, content marketing, communications, or related field. Demonstrated experience in Arabic translation, localization, or LQA, with a proven track record of leading projects from inception to completion. Experience conducting localization reviews, testing, and managing language quality initiatives for Arabic-speaking markets. Hands-on experience using AI/ LLM tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, MT engines) in localization workflows, including prompt design, AI output QA, and post-editing. Comfort iterating on prompts and AI-assisted review pipelines. Proficiency with Translation Management Systems (TMS) and Content Management Systems (CMS). Experience in creative translation and transcreation, with the ability to adapt content to fit Arabic cultural context (including dialect/MSA decisions, gender, formality, religious and cultural sensitivity). Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams; product, design, content, engineering, marketing, and external vendors. Ability to conduct market research, gather customer feedback, and provide insights on UI/UX design to enhance local user experience. Experience assessing and managing language service providers, including feedback, training, and performance management. Nice-To-Haves Familiarity with SEO fundamentals and content performance metrics in the Arabic market. Experience with prompt engineering or AI-assisted content quality governance frameworks. Knowledge of RTL design considerations and how they impact Arabic UX. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Proficiency in one or more additional languages. Action-oriented, dedicated self-starter. Passion for crypto and blockchain innovations. Perks Benefits Competitive total compensation package L D programs and education subsidy for employees growth and development Various team building programs and company events Wellness and meal allowances Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants More that we love to tell you along the process! Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle for assigned product lines (e.g. VIP Loan, Credit Line, Delayed Settlement, MM programs, or fund management tools). Gather and prioritise product and client requirements using data-driven analysis. Client Engagement and Growth Develop strategic partnerships and maintain relationships with key institutional clients. Coordinate with RM/BD teams on client onboarding, tier management, and retention strategies. Drive quarterly growth strategies in collaboration with Core Trading, Retail Growth, and Earn teams, including cross-sell initiatives, incentive program design, and institutional product bundling. Build business cases for product and partnership investments with clear ROI frameworks. Quantify the revenue and AUM impact of product features to drive prioritisation decisions. Own the commercial logic of assigned institutional product lines. What We Look For In You Proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product launch throughout its lifecycle. Adept at translating product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes. Experience with institutional credit products (margin lending, secured financing, delayed settlement, or credit line structures) is preferred. Proven experience engaging directly with institutional clients — Conducting business reviews, gathering requirements on-site, and translating client pain points into product roadmap priorities. Strong written and verbal skills for producing high quality documents, plans, roadmaps and presentations with impact. Comfortable working across time zones and cultural contexts. Understanding of institutional crypto market dynamics — Fee structures, market making, prime brokerage models, and custody solutions. Deep understanding of crypto exchange products (spot, margin, futures, perpetual swaps, options) and institutional trading workflows. TradFi experience in FX, Equities, or Fixed Income covering trading and middle/back office is a strong plus. About The Opportunity You will have the opportunity to join a team responsible for designing the industry s leading Crypto trading system, including Spot, Margin, Perpetuals, Futures, Options, and various risk control models such as simple account, single-currency margin, multi-currency margin, and portfolio margin. This system supports daily trading volumes of over ten billion USD for both retail and institutional clients. What You’ll Be Doing The plumbing of the exchange. Order management, matching, margin, risk engine, lending/borrowing — across both spot and derivatives. When you ship, millions of trades route through your work the same day. Infrastructure that holds up where others can t operate. You ll work directly with Legal, Compliance, and local market teams — not to check boxes, but to design systems that clear the highest regulatory bar in finance. That bar is our moat. Outlearning the competition. Talk to traders, take apart competing systems, and decide where we lead vs. fast-follow — across crypto and TradFi. The instruments that show us the market first. Build the data and monitoring layer that gives us situational awareness of our own stack and the broader industry. If something s drifting, breaking, or shifting — you know before anyone else. The 3–12 month direction. Decide what we build next, and when, based on product lifecycle, competitive landscape, and what our capacity actually is — not what makes the deck look good. The AI harness and agent architecture for your domain. Design and ship multi-step agent workflows — tool use, retrieval, evaluation, human-in-the-loop checkpoints — that power how Core Trading operates. Spec agents the way you spec products. What We Look For In You Bachelor s degree or above in mathematics, physics or computer science major. 5+ years experience in building sophisticated backend systems in either crypto or Traditional Finance industry. AI native skillset that allow you to ship at 10x because you automate the work flow first. Possess rigorous logical thinking, excellent teamwork, communication skills and be able to coordinate resources to solve problems and achieve goals between different departments. You possess a strong interest in trading, blockchain and the financial industry. You are proactive, enthusiastic and sensitive to customers feedback from a product lens. Fluent in English and Mandarin (to communicate with Mandarin speaking clients / cross-teams). Nice-To-Haves Trading experience in sophisticated institutions. Excel in quantitative research with various mathematics tools. Growth is the core mandate of this role — you will own analytics that power how we acquire, activate, and retain users across global markets. You will serve as the analytical backbone for our growth function: measuring channel performance, evaluating the impact of campaigns and promotions, and identifying the levers that move our most important metrics. Beyond analysis, you will design and build AI-powered analytics tools and systems that enable the team to generate insights faster and at greater scale. What You’ll Be Doing Growth Channel Analytics Own end-to-end measurement of acquisition channels — paid media, referral, affiliate, and organic — tracking performance, efficiency, and ROI; partner with channel owners to surface actionable signals in near real-time. Growth Campaign Promotion Analytics Lead analytics for growth campaigns, incentive programs, and promotional events — from pre-launch sizing to post-launch readouts. Develop incrementality measurement methodologies (holdout tests, synthetic control, difference-in-differences) and build reusable frameworks that reduce time-to-insight for recurring programs. User Lifecycle Retention Analytics Partner with growth teams to measure activation, engagement, and monetization across the full lifecycle; build cohort analyses, retention models, and segmentation frameworks to identify high-value segments and growth levers. Experimentation Design and execute A/B tests; ensure statistical rigor and deliver clear, actionable readouts to growth and product stakeholders. AI-Powered Analytics Tools Systems Design and build AI-based analytics tools, agents, and automated insight systems — LLM query interfaces, anomaly detection pipelines, and self-serve tooling that democratizes data access across growth and product teams. Apply expertise in LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows to solve real analytical problems at scale; stay current with AI developments and continuously bring new capabilities into the team’s workflow. Stakeholder Partnership Serve as the primary analytical partner to growth leads and PMs — translating complex analyses into clear, actionable narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences. What We Look For In You Education Experience Master s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. 5+ years in data science or growth analytics (fintech/crypto preferred), with a demonstrated track record of moving metrics — not just reporting them. Growth Analytics Expertise Deep experience across the growth analytics stack — channel performance, campaign incrementality, acquisition funnel, cohort retention, and lifecycle segmentation — with strong intuition for what’s working and why. Familiarity with paid acquisition channels, referral and affiliate programs, and promotional mechanics — and how to measure their true impact. AI Engineering Capability Proven experience building AI-powered analytics tools or systems — not just using AI assistants, but designing and deploying them (e.g. LLM-based query tools, automated insight pipelines, AI agents for data workflows). Strong Python; hands-on with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG, and agentic frameworks; able to rapidly evaluate and integrate new AI tooling into production workflows. Technical Skills Expert-level SQL; proficiency in Python for analysis, modeling, and automation. Hands-on experience designing and analyzing A/B experiments; solid understanding of statistical inference and experimentation best practices. Experience building dashboards, self-serve data tools, and automated pipelines; familiarity with predictive modeling, user segmentation, and cohort analysis. Industry Knowledge Experience in the crypto industry or crypto trading is required. Candidates should have hands-on knowledge of CEX/DEX dynamics, token economics, or crypto user behavior and be able to apply this understanding to shape product and growth strategies. Growth Mindset Experience working directly with growth leads and product managers in a fast-moving, agile environment. Comfortable defining metrics from scratch and building analytical frameworks in ambiguous, high-growth contexts. Communication Strong data storytelling and stakeholder communication skills — able to distill complex analyses into actionable narratives and influence decisions at the senior level. About The Team Our Trading Product Group leads the design of all the products on OKX s derivatives trading exchange, including spot trading, spot margin, futures, leveraged tokens, trading options etc. What You’ll Be Doing AI Agent Review Escalation - Review AI agent outputs across risk monitoring workflows — assess findings for accuracy, identify false positives, and escalate risk events through the appropriate channels with clear, well-documented rationale. Risk Patrol Operation - Operate AI-assisted investigation workflows covering key risk metrics. Verify agent reasoning, identify analytical gaps, and ensure the quality output of investigations. Market Abuse Investigation - Review AI-surfaced signals related to suspected market abuse, assess the validity, and escalate to the appropriate team with a structured findings report. SOP Development Agent Skill Authorship - Translate frontline risk experience into structured SOPs and agent skill sets. Identify blind spots in current detection logic, document edge cases, and collaborate with the Product team to continuously improve automated coverage. Risk System Quality Review - Conduct regular reviews of agent performance — assessing output quality, surfacing systematic errors, and proposing refinements. Serve as a quality gate between automated risk outputs and business-level decisions. Cross-Functional Risk Coordination - Communicate escalated risk findings clearly to Product, Compliance, Legal, and Operations teams. Ensure AI-generated intelligence is accurately interpreted and translated into actionable, well-documented recommendations. What We Look For In You 3+ years in trading risk, ideally at a crypto exchange or derivatives venue. Deep knowledge of attack vectors: pump-and-dump, wash trading, liquidation suicide attacks, Sybil patterns, flash crashes. Strong data intuition — Able to QA AI-generated analysis, spot anomalies in outputs, and challenge agent conclusions. Comfort operating in an AI-augmented workflow: prompting agents, reading structured outputs, making final calls under time pressure. Excellent judgment in ambiguous, high-pressure situations — You decide, the agent advises. Cross-functional collaboration skills; able to work with PMs, engineers, and compliance. Nice-To-Haves Hands-on experience with LLM-based tools, SQL, or Python — Enough to validate AI-generated queries. Personal trading experience or financial risk certification (FRM/CFA). Mandarin proficiency for collaboration with technical teams. Experience writing or refining risk SOPs or runbooks. jobs.title: Senior Visual Designer
jobs.description: OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX s sponsorship of a visa. Who We Are OKX is one of the world s leading crypto platforms — a regulated exchange, a self-custody wallet, and a growing ecosystem of decentralized applications used by millions globally. We move fast, ship constantly, and operate across trading, DeFi, payments, and social products — each with distinct users and design challenges. Our design organization is in the middle of a meaningful transformation: raising craft standards, building tighter brand-to-product coherence, and embedding AI into how we work. We re backed by our core principles — We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done — and we take those seriously in how we hire, build, and ship. About the Opportunity We re looking for a Senior Visual/UI Designer to join the Visual System Team — the team responsible for how OKX looks and feels across every product surface (Mobile + Web). You ll work at the intersection of brand expression and product design, crafting the visual layer that makes OKX products feel distinctive, coherent, and trusted. This isn t a role where you receive a finalized wireframe and skin it. You ll be involved early — shaping how features are visually conceived, how brand moments are integrated into product flows, and how visual systems scale across an ecosystem of products used by millions. You ll work within OKX s Visual Systems infrastructure alongside the Design System and Content System teams, contributing to scalable visual frameworks — illustration guidelines, motion principles, iconography standards, and brand-in-product patterns — that raise quality across the entire product. What You’ll Be Doing Design product visual experiences. Create high-quality visual and UI design for OKX products — spanning trading, wallet, payments, and social features. Own the visual execution of key product surfaces, from concept through to pixel-perfect delivery. Balance beauty with clarity in a domain where trust and usability are non-negotiable. Contribute to visual systems. Work within and contribute to OKX s visual systems — shared illustration styles, motion tokens, color systems, iconography, and layout patterns. Your work should strengthen the system, not create one-off exceptions. Think in terms of reusable, scalable assets, not just deliverables. Use AI tools in your design workflow. Actively integrate AI into your daily practice — using generative tools for ideation, exploration, variation, and asset production. You re expected to experiment with AI-assisted workflows and bring what works back to the team. This is a core part of how we work, not an optional extra. Bridge brand and product. Translate brand direction into in-product visual experiences. Work with the Brand Design team to ensure that visual identity is consistent from marketing to core product — same palette, same sensibility, same quality bar. Collaborate cross-functionally. Partner with product designers, engineers, and product managers to ensure visual design decisions are grounded in user needs and technically feasible. Participate in design reviews, give and receive critique constructively, and communicate your rationale clearly. Pitch and present. Propose creative concepts to team leads and stakeholders. Articulate the reasoning behind visual choices — not just what you designed, but why it s the right solution for the user and the brand. What We Look For In You 4–6 years of experience in visual design or UI design, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong craft, attention to detail, and modern design sensibility across digital products. Mobile-first experience is essential. Fluency with AI design tools — you actively use tools like Midjourney, DALL·E, Figma AI features, or similar generative tools in your design workflow for ideation, exploration, and production. You don t just know about them; you use them to work faster and think wider. Strong visual craft — typography, color, composition, layout, and a keen eye for detail. You deliver pixel-perfect work and care about the micro-interactions and polish that separate good from great. Experience contributing to or working within design systems — you understand tokens, components, and how individual design decisions connect to a larger visual language. Proficiency in Figma and prototyping tools. Ability to produce high-fidelity prototypes that communicate motion and interaction intent. Solid understanding of human-centered design principles and how visual design serves usability, trust, and emotional connection — not just aesthetics. Clear communication skills — you can articulate design rationale, present to stakeholders, receive critique gracefully, and collaborate with non-designers. Nice to Haves Experience designing for fintech, crypto, or trading platforms — you understand the visual language of trust, precision, and data density. Illustration or motion skills — you can create original visual assets, not just compose them. Experience working with globally distributed teams across offices and time zones. Familiarity with how visual design integrates with front-end implementation — you understand CSS, design tokens, and component architecture well enough to collaborate effectively with engineers. jobs.title: Product Manager (Crypto Core)
jobs.description: Working At Bitso We are a diverse team that takes pride in understanding the perspectives of others. We fully embrace working remotely and we are eager to act, improve and accelerate progress inside and outside of our organization. To drive revolutionary changes in society and make crypto useful, we delight our customers with world-class products, deep care, and intentional empathy. Your Purpose Fleet: Money Movement Squad: Crypto Core As a PM in Crypto Core, you own one of the most operationally critical systems in Money Movement — responsible for the safe, reliable movement of crypto assets across multiple custody providers and chains, with direct impact on asset integrity, reconciliation, and the experience of millions of users. This role sits at the intersection of execution and system understanding. You will own day-to-day product execution while building deep knowledge of how the system behaves under scale, failure, and operational stress. This is not a feature backlog role. It is infrastructure with real financial consequences. At Bitso, how we operate matters as much as what we operate: Customer Obsession: Guaranteeing that every crypto transaction is processed reliably, with the operational discipline that protects user trust at scale. Freedom with Accountability: Making trade-off decisions independently, with full ownership of the consequences. Continuous Innovation: Actively using AI to sharpen your own work and identify where the system can become smarter, faster, and more resilient. Reports To Group Product Manager, Money Movement Who You Are Experienced PM: You have 4–6 years of experience in Product Management, with meaningful exposure to fintech, payments, or technical infrastructure. You have a proven track record of delivering under complexity without losing quality. Technically Fluent: You don t code, but you are genuinely comfortable reasoning about APIs, asynchronous systems, external integrations, and failure scenarios. You ask where can this break? before proposing solutions. System-Aware: You understand what it means to work on infrastructure where errors have real financial and operational consequences. You treat reliability and integrity as design constraints, not operational afterthoughts. Clear Communicator: You operate as a bridge between engineering and business stakeholders — translating technical constraints into business language and business priorities into clear technical direction. Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can operate with partial information and evolving context without losing direction. You escalate risks clearly and early, even when the solution isn t yet defined. AI-Native: You actively use AI tools as part of how you work — drafting specs, synthesizing information, analyzing risk, structuring decisions. You apply judgment on top of AI output. You know when to trust it and when to push back. Nice to have: Experience with crypto custody, wallet infrastructure, or blockchain systems Exposure to reconciliation, ledger, or treasury-related systems Multi-region product experience in regulated environments What You Will Do Own end-to-end product execution for Crypto Core: prioritization, scoping, delivery, and quality across multi-chain transaction processing and wallet operations Coordinate with custody and infrastructure providers to maintain and evolve platform reliability Drive cross-squad alignment with transaction orchestration and financial reconciliation teams Translate operational and technical signals — incidents, failures, edge cases — into clear product actions Surface system risks, inconsistencies, and gaps proactively, and drive them to resolution with the right stakeholders Keep engineering focused on high-impact, system-relevant problems Use AI tools consistently to raise the quality and speed of your output — specs, analyses, risk assessments, and communications What Good Looks Like (Year 1) The system maintains or improves its operational reliability — no regressions in critical flows Incidents are surfaced earlier, triaged faster, and followed by clear product or system improvements You have developed a strong understanding of system behavior, including key edge cases and failure modes Risks and inconsistencies are made explicit and actively managed, not discovered reactively You are contributing meaningfully to system-level discussions with engineering and product leadership Engineering trusts your judgment and prioritization Your use of AI is visible in the quality and consistency of your output — not as a novelty, but as a standard working practice What This Role Is Not A web3 / DeFi or consumer crypto product role A purely delivery-focused role with pre-defined specs A role where ambiguity is removed before you act A position focused on growth, UX optimization, or surface-level features A role where AI usage is optional or decorative — we expect it to be part of how you work Research in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion suggests that individuals may hesitate to apply for jobs if they do not meet all the listed criteria. At Bitso, we value diversity and your unique strengths could be just what we re looking for. If this role excites you but you don t match every point in the description, we still want to hear from you. #LI-Remote Who We Are With over 9 million users, Bitso is the leading cryptocurrency platform in Latin America. We are developing the cryptocurrency ecosystem in the region and enabling financial inclusion. We believe crypto is the future of finance, and we’re committed to making it useful by providing equal access to safe and intuitive financial products. When we hire people for our team, we specifically test for the following traits in addition to our cultural values: Mission-Driven : We seek individuals who are passionate about crypto and Bitso’s mission and resilient in facing industry challenges High Sense of Urgency : We prioritize candidates who demonstrate a high sense of urgency and responsibility. Exceptional Hard Skills : We seek individuals who possess exceptional skills in their respective fields, with no room for mediocrity. Self-Management : We look for individuals who can independently manage their work, career, and professional development. Compensation Benefits At Bitso, you are taking the front seat on the edge of crypto innovation, creating the next generation of crypto-powered products. So for those willing to commit, adapt and pioneer the most important change of the century we offer: Me Time program, including unlimited paid time off. Remote-first work environment. Employee Stock Option program. Zero trading fees through our Bitso Alpha app. Extended Family Leave Policy: all birthing parents, non-birthing parents and adopting parents are eligible for a 4-months leave. Premium health, dental and life insurances in Mexico, Gibraltar, Colombia, USA, Brazil and Argentina. Want to leave an undoubtedly legacy with us? Fasten your seatbelt and join this spaceship, where you will find exponential growth and the opportunity to thrive! Avec une équipe talentueuse de challengers curieux qui savent s’adapter et remettre en question le statu quo. Du betreust ein Portfolio deutscher Geschäftskunden und sorgst für ein reibungsloses Banking-Erlebnis. Du berichtest an Sanja Kadžibanov, die unser Customer Care Team Deutschland leitet. Standort: Belgrad (Büro) oder remote in Serbien. ➡️ Was du tun wirst Komplexe Kundenanfragen bearbeiten: Kontopfändungen, blockierte Zahlungen, Kontoschließungen, erweiterte Sorgfaltspflichtprüfungen — du bearbeitest anspruchsvolle Fälle mit Sorgfalt und Präzision. Zahlungsdienstleistungen unterstützen: Kunden bei Fragen und Problemen rund um Zahlungen, Überweisungen und Kontoaktivitäten beraten und schnelle Lösungen liefern. VIP-Eskalationen priorisieren: Anfragen wichtiger Kunden mit besonderer Aufmerksamkeit bearbeiten und sicherstellen, dass ihre Anliegen zeitnah gelöst werden. Wissensbasen effizient nutzen: Schnell durch unsere Wissensdatenbanken navigieren, um präzise Informationen zu finden und Kunden kompetent zu beraten. Zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung beitragen: Muster in Kundenanfragen identifizieren und Erkenntnisse teilen, die zur Verbesserung unserer Prozesse und Produkte beitragen. ➡️ Was wir suchen Erfahrung im Kundenservice: Mindestens ein Jahr in einem kundenorientierten Bereich, idealerweise im Finanz- oder Dienstleistungssektor. Du hast komplexe Fälle bearbeitet, nicht nur Standardanfragen. Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse: Fließend mit ausgezeichneter Grammatik, Rechtschreibung und Zeichensetzung — du schreibst auf dem Niveau, das deutsche Geschäftskunden erwarten. Gute Englischkenntnisse ebenfalls erforderlich. Kundenorientierung: Du zeigst Empathie und kommunizierst auch in schwierigen Situationen professionell und lösungsorientiert. Detailorientierung: Du arbeitest präzise und sorgfältig, besonders bei Fällen mit rechtlichen Implikationen — ein übersehenes Detail kann den Fall verändern. jobs.title: Customer Onboarding Officer - German market 🇩🇪
jobs.description: Unsere Mission und Kunden: Wir schaffen die Freiheit für KMUs, erfolgreich zu sein - mit Europas führendem Finanz-Workspace, der Banking als Kern mit leistungsstarken Finanztools verbindet. Wir sind stolz auf unsere Trustpilot-Bewertung von 4,8, die auf über 55.000 Rezensionen basiert. Kundenzufriedenheit steht im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns(und hier) - belegt durch einen Net Promoter Score von 75. Unser Weg: 2017 von Alexandre und Steve gegründet, ist Qonto auf über 1.600 Qontoers gewachsen, die mehr als 600.000 Kunden in acht europäischen Ländern betreuen. Seit 2023 sind wir profitabel - und das ist erst der Anfang. Unsere Überzeugungen: Wir stellen nach Fähigkeiten und Potenzial ein. Mit über 80 Nationalitäten, 45 % Frauen im Unternehmen und 56 % Frauen in unserem Leadership-Team ist Diversität kein Programm – sie ist Teil unserer DNA. Wir haben einen diskriminierungsfreien Einstellungsprozess aufgebaut, weil die besten Teams auf Leistung basieren. KI bei Qonto: KI ist fest in unsere Arbeitsweise integriert (hier). Jede/r Qontoer/in hat unbegrenzten Zugang zu den besten KI-Tools. Wir suchen Menschen, die experimentieren, ohne auf Erlaubnis zu warten, KI über das Offensichtliche hinaus nutzen und wissen, wann man ihr vertrauen kann - und wann man sie hinterfragen sollte. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Werde Teil unseres Customer Onboarding Teams als Customer Onboarding Manager Deutschland und begleite deutsche Unternehmer und Selbstständige bei Firmengründung, Kontoeröffnung und Kontovalidierung. Du bearbeitest komplexe Anfragen rund um den gesamten Onboarding-Prozess und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Start mit Qonto. Du berichtest an Mirela Jovanovic und Rafael Hajzeri, Team Manager im Customer Onboarding / KYC/KYB Operations Bereich. Standort: Belgrad (Büro) oder remote in Serbien. ➡️ Was du tun wirst Komplexe Onboarding-Anfragen bearbeiten: Anspruchsvolle Fälle rund um Firmengründung, Kontovalidierung, Stammkapitalzahlungen und Kontoaktivierung mit hoher Sorgfalt und Präzision lösen. Kunden durch die Onboarding-Journey begleiten: Klare, schnelle und verlässliche Antworten auf Fragen rund um Kontoeröffnung und regulierte Prozesse liefern. Sensible und dringende Fälle priorisieren: Besonders bei Kontovalidierungen zeitnah und mit besonderer Aufmerksamkeit handeln — Verzögerungen hier bedeuten, dass ein Unternehmer nicht arbeiten kann. Wissensbasen effizient nutzen: Sicher durch unsere Wissensdatenbanken navigieren, um präzise Informationen zu finden und Kunden kompetent zu beraten. Zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung beitragen: Muster in Kundenanfragen erkennen, Erkenntnisse mit dem Team teilen und so Prozesse und Kundenerlebnis verbessern. ➡️ Was wir suchen Erfahrung im Kundenservice oder Operations: Mindestens ein Jahr in einer kundenorientierten Rolle, idealerweise im Finanz-, Operations- oder Dienstleistungsumfeld. Du hast komplexe Fälle bearbeitet, nicht nur Standardanfragen. Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse: Fließend mit ausgezeichneter Grammatik, Rechtschreibung und Zeichensetzung. Gute Englischkenntnisse sind ebenfalls erforderlich. Kundenorientierung: Du kommunizierst empathisch, professionell und lösungsorientiert — auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen, in denen Kunden auf ihre Kontoeröffnung warten. Detailorientierung: Du arbeitest präzise und sorgfältig, besonders bei regulierten Prozessen wie KYC/KYB-Validierungen — ein Fehler hier hat direkte Konsequenzen. Belastbarkeit: Du behältst auch bei hohem Arbeitsaufkommen einen klaren Kopf, setzt Prioritäten und bleibst lösungsorientiert. ➡️ Was wir dir bieten Der erste Kontakt für deutsche Unternehmer: Du begleitest Kunden beim allerersten Schritt mit Qonto — Firmengründung und Kontoeröffnung. Deine Arbeit bestimmt den ersten Eindruck. Komplexe, regulierte Prozesse: KYC/KYB-Validierungen, Stammkapitalzahlungen, Kontoaktivierung — das ist kein Standard-Kundensupport, sondern Arbeit mit direkter regulatorischer Relevanz. Ein Team mit über 100 Mitarbeitenden: Du arbeitest in einer etablierten Onboarding-Organisation mit klaren Strukturen, Team Leads und definierten Eskalationswegen. Flexibilität: Zwei Bürotage pro Woche in Belgrad, ansonsten remote in Serbien. ➡️ Über deine zukünftigen Führungskräfte Du berichtest an Mirela Jovanovic und Rafael Hajzeri, Team Leads im Customer Onboarding Germany. Mirelas Werdegang? 6+ Jahre bei Qonto — sie startete als Customer Relationship Management Managerin, betreute den deutschen Markt drei Jahre lang und wurde 2023 zum Team Lead Onboarding Germany befördert. Davor sammelte sie Erfahrung als Administration Manager und Customer Support Specialist. Studium der Germanistik an der Universität Belgrad. Rafaels Werdegang? Fast 4 Jahre bei Qonto — Rafael startete als Customer Success Manager in Barcelona und wurde 2025 zum Customer Onboarding Lead befördert. Davor war er Technical Support Representative bei Majorel und Hotel Specialist in Bayern. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, basiert in Barcelona. Was bringen sie dem Team? Eine Arbeitskultur, die auf Struktur, Verlässlichkeit und professionellem Kundenumgang basiert. Beide haben ihren Weg bei Qonto von operativen Rollen bis zur Teamleitung gemacht — sie kennen die Arbeit, die du tun wirst, aus eigener Erfahrung und wissen, wie man in dieser Organisation wächst. Mit Ihrer Bewerbung erklären Sie sich damit einverstanden, dass Qonto Ihre personenbezogenen Daten zur Bewertung Ihrer Bewerbung verarbeitet. Ihre Daten werden bis zu 2 Jahren in unserem Bewerberpool gespeichert. Alle Details finden Sie in unserer Datenschutzerklärung. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Unser Einstellungsprozess dauert im Durchschnitt 20 Arbeitstage. Mehr Informationen über den Bewerbungsprozess findest du hier. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 🔒 Deine Sicherheit ist uns wichtig Betrugsversuche im Recruiting nehmen zu. Wir arbeiten nie mit Drittplattformen oder Agenturen zusammen, die Zahlungen von Bewerbern verlangen. Wenn du eine verdächtige Nachricht erhältst, die vorgibt, von Qonto zu stammen, melde sie bitte umgehend an support@qonto.com.

Improve conversion and GTM effectiveness - Partner closely with sales and product to understand objections, stalled deals and increase buyer clarity. - Adjust messaging, use cases, and campaigns based on feedback from the field. - Scale activity once fundamentals are working, prioritizing signal before volume. Lay foundations for scale - Establish lightweight workflows, metrics, and operating cadence so marketing can scale responsibly over time. - Use modern tools, including AI, to increase leverage without adding unnecessary processes. jobs.title: Manager/Senior Manager, Operational Risk & Controls
jobs.description: ABOUT KOHO We’re on a mission to make financial services better for every Canadian. That means no hidden fees, no predatory interest rates - just financial products designed to help our users spend smart, save more, and build real wealth. We’re a performance organization with a strong heart: we care deeply about outcomes, and everything ties back to our mission - to financially empower a generation of Canadians. At KOHO, we’re not your average 9-5. We believe real impact comes from people who are trusted, empowered, and supported to do their best work - without sacrificing their lives to do it. We prioritize work-life integration, not just work-life balance. That means asynchronous collaboration, flexible hours, and a remote-first setup built around autonomy and high trust. KOHO is entering its next chapter - leaner, smarter, more AI-integrated. We’re building for impact, not bureaucracy. If you thrive in environments that value clarity, ownership, and bold thinking, you’ll fit right in. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a highly motivated Manager/Senior Manager, Operational Risk Management to join our Operational Risk Management (ORM) team. Reporting to the Director, ORM, this role will execute and enhance our risk assessment processes and drive the tactical delivery of the Second Line Controls Testing program. The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in controls testing and operational risk management, with a passion for leveraging AI, automation, and innovative technologies. WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING OPERATIONAL RISK LEADERSHIP - Evolve KOHO’s operational risk management framework and practices aligned with applicable OSFI Guidelines (E-21, B-10, E-13) and banking industry standards. - Lead end-to-end development and implementation of a Second Line Controls Testing program, including methodology, governance, and reporting standards. - Identify emerging operational risks and trends and develop implementation strategies. CONTROLS TESTING PROGRAM & EXECUTION - Lead and own the day-to-day operations of the Second Line Controls Testing program, ensuring timely completion of testing activities in accordance with established methodology and standards. - Lead the development of the annual Controls Testing plan, including risk-based scoping and prioritization of testing activities. - Develop and maintain test scripts, workpapers, and documentation to support testing conclusions and findings and improve program quality and consistency. - Prepare testing status reports and summaries for Management review and Risk Committee reporting - Track and monitor remediation activities, partnering with First Line business owners to ensure timely closure of identified issues. - Establish and implement Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) for independent controls testing execution; Develop and maintain a quality assurance (QA) process to ensure completeness, accuracy, and quality of BPO agent outputs. - Perform and/or oversee the independent testing of First Line controls to assess design effectiveness, operating effectiveness, and control suite coverage across key business processes and risk areas. RISK ASSESSMENT & MONITORING - Support the execution of enterprise-wide Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs), partnering with 1st Line business units to identify, assess, and document operational risks and controls. - Support the operational risk event and loss data collection process, assisting in root cause analysis and trend identification. - Assist in the preparation of thematic reviews and lessons learned analyses to drive continuous improvement in the control environment. STAKEHOLDER ENGAGEMENT & COLLABORATION - Build and maintain strong working relationships with First Line business partners, serving as a collaborative and constructive partner in risk management activities - Partner with colleagues in Compliance, Risk Management, and Internal Audit to ensure integrated risk oversight and coverage. AI, AUTOMATION & INNOVATION - Identify opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning, RPA, and data analytics to enhance controls testing and risk assessment efficiency. - Support deployment of automated testing scripts, intelligent workflows, and advanced reporting tools. - Collaborate with Technology teams to evaluate and implement emerging RegTech solutions. - Stay current on industry trends, regulatory developments, and best practices in operational risk management and controls testing. Who You Are - You have 7+ years in operational risk, controls testing, internal audit, or compliance within financial services. - You have a solid understanding of the connectivities across non-financial risk domains (compliance, third party, business continuity, tech/cyber, etc.) - You have strong analytical, critical thinking, communication, and interpersonal skills. - You’ve worked in regulated fintech, neobank, or direct-to-consumer financial institutions. - You’re passionate about innovation, inclusion, and empowering financial wellness. The budgeted salary range for this role is $110,000-$170,000 CAD / year. At KOHO, we are dedicated to providing pay transparency to all candidates. Compensation at KOHO is determined through various factors including but not limited to: comparable salary market data within Canada, technical skill assessment, a holistic view of previous work history, and internal pay equity with other KOHO team members. Description de poste en français Nous sommes à la recherche d’un ou d’une gestionnaire / gestionnaire principal(e) motivé(e), Gestion des risques opérationnels pour joindre notre équipe de gestion des risques opérationnels (GRO). Relevant du directeur ou de la directrice, GRO, la personne titulaire de ce poste exécutera et optimisera nos processus d’évaluation des risques et pilotera la mise en œuvre tactique du programme d'évaluation des contrôles de deuxième ligne. Le candidat ou la candidate idéal(e) possédera une solide expérience en évaluation des contrôles et en gestion des risques opérationnels, ainsi qu'une passion pour l'utilisation de l'IA, de l'automatisation et des technologies innovantes. VOS RESPONSABILITÉS LEADERSHIP EN GESTION DES RISQUES OPÉRATIONNELS - Faire évoluer le cadre et les pratiques de gestion des risques opérationnels de KOHO, conformément aux lignes directrices applicables du BSIF (E-21, B-10, E-13) et aux normes du secteur bancaire. - Diriger le développement et la mise en œuvre de bout en bout d'un programme d'évaluation des contrôles de deuxième ligne, y compris la méthodologie, la gouvernance et les normes de production de rapports. - Identifier les risques opérationnels émergents ainsi que les tendances, et élaborer des stratégies de mise en œuvre. EXÉCUTION ET PROGRAMME D'ÉVALUATION DES CONTRÔLES - Diriger et prendre en charge les opérations quotidiennes du programme d'évaluation des contrôles de deuxième ligne, en veillant à ce que les activités d'évaluation soient réalisées en temps opportun, conformément à la méthodologie et aux normes établies. - Diriger l'élaboration du plan annuel d'évaluation des contrôles, y compris la définition de la portée axée sur les risques et la hiérarchisation des activités d'évaluation. - Développer et maintenir les scénarios de test (scripts), les documents de travail et la documentation afin de soutenir les conclusions et les constats d'évaluation, tout en améliorant la qualité et la cohérence du programme. - Préparer des rapports d'étape et des résumés d'évaluation pour examen par la direction et pour présentation au comité des risques. - Suivre et surveiller les activités de remédiation, en partenariat avec les responsables d'unités d'affaires de première ligne, afin de garantir la résolution rapide des problèmes identifiés. - Établir et mettre en œuvre l'externalisation des processus d'affaires (BPO) pour l'exécution indépendante de l'évaluation des contrôles ; développer et maintenir un processus d'assurance qualité (AQ) pour garantir l'exhaustivité, l'exactitude et la qualité du travail des agents de BPO. - Effectuer et/ou superviser l'évaluation indépendante des contrôles de première ligne afin de mesurer l'efficacité de leur conception, leur efficacité opérationnelle et la couverture de la gamme de contrôles dans l'ensemble des processus d'affaires et des domaines de risques clés. ÉVALUATION ET SURVEILLANCE DES RISQUES - Soutenir l'exécution des auto-évaluations des risques et des contrôles (RCSA) à l'échelle de l'entreprise, en partenariat avec les unités d'affaires de première ligne pour identifier, évaluer et documenter les risques opérationnels et les contrôles. - Soutenir le processus de collecte de données sur les incidents de risque opérationnel et les pertes financières, en participant à l'analyse des causes premières et à l'identification des tendances. - Collaborer à la préparation de revues thématiques et d'analyses des leçons apprises afin de favoriser l'amélioration continue de l'environnement de contrôle. ENGAGEMENT DES PARTIES PRENANTES ET COLLABORATION - Bâtir et maintenir de solides relations de travail avec les partenaires d'affaires de première ligne, en agissant comme un partenaire collaboratif et constructif dans les activités de gestion des risques. - Collaborer avec les collègues des équipes de la conformité, de la gestion des risques et de l'audit interne afin d'assurer une surveillance et une couverture intégrées des risques. IA, AUTOMATISATION ET INNOVATION - Identifier les occasions de tirer parti de l'IA, de l'apprentissage automatique, de l'automatisation robotisée des processus (RPA) et de l'analyse de données afin d'améliorer l'efficacité de l'évaluation des contrôles et de la gestion des risques. - Soutenir le déploiement de scénarios de test automatisés, de flux de travail intelligents et d'outils de rapports avancés. - Collaborer avec les équipes technologiques pour évaluer et mettre en œuvre les solutions RegTech émergentes. - Rester à l'affût des tendances de l'industrie, des développements réglementaires et des meilleures pratiques en matière de gestion des risques opérationnels et d'évaluation des contrôles. PROFIL RECHERCHÉ - Vous possédez plus de 7 ans d'expérience en gestion des risques opérationnels, en évaluation des contrôles, en audit interne ou en conformité au sein du secteur des services financiers. - Vous comprenez parfaitement les interconnexions entre les différents domaines de risques non financiers (conformité, tiers fournisseurs, continuité des activités, technologies/cybersécurité, etc.). - Vous possédez de fortes capacités d'analyse et d'esprit critique, ainsi que d'excellentes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles. - Vous avez travaillé au sein d'une fintech réglementée, d'une néobanque ou d'une institution financière s'adressant directement aux consommateurs. - Vous êtes passionné(e) par l'innovation, l'inclusion et l'autonomie financière. RÉMUNÉRATION ET AVANTAGES La fourchette salariale budgétisée pour ce poste est de 110 000 $ à 170 000 $ CA par année. Chez KOHO, nous nous faisons un point d'honneur d'offrir une pleine transparence salariale à l'ensemble des candidats et candidates. La rémunération chez KOHO est déterminée en fonction de plusieurs facteurs, incluant notamment : les données comparatives du marché salarial au Canada, l'évaluation des compétences techniques, une analyse globale des antécédents professionnels, ainsi que l'équité salariale interna avec les autres membres de l'équipe de KOHO. ABOUT THE ROLE KOHO is looking for a Director, Financial Risk to lead the strategy and analytics efforts within our financial risk management function. In this pivotal role, you will oversee both Credit Risk and Non-Credit Financial Risk (including Market and Liquidity Risk), managing a team of people managers and experts to safeguard KOHO’s financial health while enabling sustainable growth. Working closely with Product, Finance, Technology, and Data teams, you will lead a team of financial risk subject matter experts in the development and implementation of analytical frameworks that drive our risk decisions and ensure regulatory compliance. In addition to being the financial risk SME in the development of risk and valuation models, you will have end-to-end ownership for risk appetite metrics and loss forecasting, IFRS 9 provisioning, and portfolio monitoring. You will also provide "effective challenge" and decision governance across the organization. WHAT YOU'LL DO LEAD & DEVELOP THE TEAM - Manage and mentor a high-performing team of people managers and individual contributors across all Financial Risk domains. - Foster a culture of rigorous analysis, ownership, and continuous improvement. FINANCIAL RISK GOVERNANCE & OVERSIGHT - Decision Governance: Establish and maintain robust decision governance frameworks for key business decisions with Financial Risk impact, ensuring that they align with KOHO’s risk appetite. - Effective Challenge: Provide "effective challenge" on decisions impacting financial risk, such as model development and performance monitoring activities by Tech/Data Science, financial risk-related inputs to stress testing provided by first-line teams, or new product or marketing initiatives proposed by Product. - Risk Appetite: Oversee and recommend the frameworks for assessing and measuring our financial risk appetite, lead the financial risk appetite approval process by senior leadership and the board, and lead the development and monitoring of the risk appetite metrics. - Policy: Lead governance for financial risk policies including credit policy, across product portfolios, monitor for behavior trends and shifts, and use monitoring results to recommend and implement immediate changes, such as tightening credit limits. - Model Risk Management: Leads second line oversight of models used in decisions impacting financial risk. FINANCIAL RISK STRATEGY & ANALYTICS - Forecasting & Provisioning: Oversee short- and long-term delinquency and loss forecasting. Lead the calculation of Expected Credit Loss (ECL), stress testing, and provisioning in strict accordance with IFRS 9 standards. - Market & Liquidity Risk: Collaborate with Finance and Treasury teams in the development and execution of forecasting frameworks for market and liquidity risk. Establish monitoring and reporting for Financial Risks. - Stress Testing: Lead the stress testing process for financial risk, including the methodology and scenario selection process. Provide effective challenge to first line teams that create the financial risk-related inputs to stress testing, including to Finance teams on liquidity and market risk-related methodologies and forecasts.. - Portfolio Monitoring: Drive portfolio risk monitoring, reporting, and insight generation to identify trends, risks, and opportunities early. Identify and drive opportunities for automated anomaly detection leveraging state-of-the-art tools and techniques. - Data Stewardship: Act as the primary steward for Financial Risk data. This includes identification and/or definition of new data sources/elements for risk-related decision making; identification/documentation of critical data elements; working with the Data and Technology teams in the documentation of all associated metadata (including data lineage); and ensuring data quality, integrity, and availability for decision-making. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION - Partner closely with Finance on capital planning, provisioning, and forecasting. Collaborate with Finance in the design, execution, and oversight of comprehensive stress testing programs for financial risks to ensure KOHO’s readiness in the face of adverse events. - Collaborate with Product Management to embed risk insights into new product development and feature optimization. - Collaborate with Marketing to assess the risk impact of marketing initiatives. - Work with Technology, Data Analytics, and Data Science to enhance risk infrastructure, data pipelines, models, and modeling capabilities. WHO YOU ARE EXPERIENCE & EDUCATION - 10+ years of experience in financial risk management, with significant exposure to retail credit risk and/or treasury/financial risk management. - Leadership: Proven experience managing people managers and leading high-performing analytical teams. - Education: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Engineering) or equivalent practical experience. SKILLS & COMPETENCIES - Technical Expertise: Deep understanding of IFRS 9 standards, ECL methodologies, and stress testing frameworks. Familiarity with market and liquidity risk principles. - Analytical Mindset: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable strategic insights. - Communication: Strong ability to communicate complex risk concepts to non-technical stakeholders and senior executive leadership. - Collaboration: A "builder" mindset—you thrive in cross-functional environments and can effectively influence peers in Product, Finance, and Tech. The budgeted salary range for this role is $180,000-$240,000 CAD / year. At KOHO, we are dedicated to providing pay transparency to all candidates. Compensation at KOHO is determined through various factors including but not limited to: comparable salary market data within Canada, technical skill assessment, a holistic view of previous work history, and internal pay equity with other KOHO team members. DESCRIPTION DE POSTE EN FRANÇAIS KOHO est à la recherche d’un·e Directeur·trice, Risque financier, pour piloter la stratégie et les analyses au sein de notre fonction de gestion du risque financier. Dans ce rôle clé, tu vas superviser à la fois le risque de crédit et le risque financier hors crédit (incluant le risque de marché et de liquidité). Tu vas diriger une équipe de gestionnaires et d’expert·es pour garder la santé financière de KOHO solide, tout en soutenant une croissance durable. En collaboration avec les équipes Produit, Finance, Technologie et Données, tu vas diriger une équipe d’expert·es en risque financier pour développer et mettre en place des cadres analytiques qui guident nos décisions de risque et assurent notre conformité réglementaire. En plus de jouer le rôle d’expert·e en risque financier dans le développement de modèles de risque et de valorisation, tu auras la responsabilité de bout en bout des métriques d’appétit pour le risque et des prévisions de pertes, de la provision IFRS 9 et du suivi de portefeuille. Tu offriras aussi un « challenge constructif » et un cadre de gouvernance décisionnelle à travers l’organisation. CE QUE TU FERAS VOICI À QUOI VA RESSEMBLER TON QUOTIDIEN. Diriger et développer l’équipe - Gérer et coacher une équipe performante de gestionnaires et de contributeur·trices individuel·les dans tous les domaines du risque financier. - Ancrer une culture d’analyse rigoureuse, de responsabilisation et d’amélioration continue. GOUVERNANCE ET SUPERVISION DU RISQUE FINANCIER - Gouvernance décisionnelle : Mettre en place et maintenir des cadres de gouvernance décisionnelle robustes pour les décisions d’affaires qui ont un impact sur le risque financier, en veillant à ce qu’elles soient alignées sur l’appétit pour le risque de KOHO. - Challenge constructif : Offrir un « challenge constructif » sur les décisions qui touchent le risque financier. Par exemple, sur le développement et le suivi de performance des modèles par les équipes Tech/Data Science, sur les intrants liés au risque financier pour les tests de résistance fournis par les équipes de première ligne (les équipes opérationnelles), ou encore sur les nouveaux produits ou initiatives marketing proposés par l’équipe Produit. - Appétit pour le risque : Superviser et recommander les cadres de mesure et d’évaluation de notre appétit pour le risque financier. Diriger le processus d’approbation de cet appétit pour le risque par la haute direction et le conseil d’administration. Piloter le développement, la définition et le suivi des métriques associées. - Politiques : Diriger la gouvernance des politiques de risque financier, y compris la politique de crédit, pour l’ensemble des portefeuilles produits. STRATÉGIE ET ANALYTIQUE EN RISQUE FINANCIER - Prévisions et provisionnement : Superviser les prévisions de défaut et de pertes à court et à long terme. Diriger le calcul de la Perte de crédit attendue (ECL), les tests de résistance et le provisionnement, en stricte conformité avec la norme IFRS 9. - Risque de marché et de liquidité : Collaborer avec les équipes Finance et Trésorerie pour développer et exécuter des cadres de prévision du risque de marché et de liquidité. Mettre en place le suivi et la production de rapports sur les risques financiers. - Tests de résistance : Diriger le processus de tests de résistance pour le risque financier, y compris la méthodologie et la sélection des scénarios. Offrir un challenge constructif aux équipes de première ligne qui créent les intrants liés au risque financier pour ces tests. Par exemple, challenger les équipes Finance sur les méthodologies et les prévisions liées au risque de liquidité et au risque de marché. - Suivi de portefeuille : Piloter la surveillance du risque de portefeuille, la production de rapports et la génération d’analyses utiles pour repérer rapidement les tendances, les risques et les opportunités qui se pointent. Identifier et mener des initiatives d’automatisation de la détection d’anomalies en s’appuyant sur des outils et techniques de pointe. - Gestion des données : Agir comme principal·e responsable des données liées au risque financier. Ça veut dire : identifier et/ou définir de nouvelles sources et de nouveaux éléments de données pour les décisions liées au risque, identifier et documenter les éléments de données critiques, travailler avec les équipes Données et Technologie pour documenter tout le métadata associé (incluant la lignée de données), et s’assurer de la qualité, de l’intégrité et de la disponibilité des données pour la prise de décision. COLLABORATION INTERFONCTIONNELLE - Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe Finance sur la planification du capital, le provisionnement et les prévisions. Collaborer avec Finance sur la conception, l’exécution et la supervision de programmes complets de tests de résistance pour les risques financiers, afin d’assurer que KOHO est prête en cas de choc défavorable. - Collaborer avec la Gestion de produit pour intégrer les analyses de risque dans le développement de nouveaux produits et l’optimisation des fonctionnalités. - Travailler avec l’équipe Marketing pour évaluer l’impact des initiatives marketing sur le risque financier. - Collaborer avec les équipes Technologie, Analyse de données et Science des données pour améliorer l’infrastructure de risque, les pipelines de données, les modèles et les capacités de modélisation. CE QUE TU APPORTES EXPÉRIENCE ET FORMATION - 10+ années d’expérience en gestion du risque financier, avec une forte exposition au risque de crédit de détail et/ou à la trésorerie et à la gestion du risque financier. - Leadership : Expérience avérée en gestion de gestionnaires et en direction d’équipes analytiques performantes. COMPÉTENCES ET APTITUDES - Expertise technique : Excellente maîtrise de la norme IFRS 9, des méthodologies ECL et des cadres de tests de résistance. Design and continuously optimize KOHO's contact strategy across the full delinquency lifecycle — including when to reach out, through which channels (chat, email, push, SMS, voice), with what messaging, and at what frequency - Evaluate and test the financial trade-offs of different recovery programs against a modelled "do nothing" baseline - Build and refine financial models to assess the value of collections treatments, cure probability by segment, and expected recovery rates at each delinquency stage BPO & Operations Partnership - Lead the strategy of KOHO's third-party collections partners (BPOs), including defining scope of engagement by delinquency stage, channel coverage (chat, dialling), performance standards, and escalation frameworks - Develop the strategy for post-charge-off debt recovery, including internal recovery, third-party debt placement, and debt sale decisions - Design the customer rehabilitation (win-back) program — defining the criteria and pathway for customers who have previously defaulted to re-engage with KOHO's products, and the risk controls required to manage that re-entry -
